### Hearts to Trust, Minds to Rest
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-june-5-2013.html
Passage: Psalm 55:22
Points:
- God knows our human fears and repeatedly reassures us of His presence.
- For every struggle—loneliness, resentment, shame, or worry—God offers comfort and provision.
- Believers are invited to rely wholly on divine grace rather than self-reliance.
- True rest of mind and heart comes from leaning on God's trustworthiness.

### What To Do When Your Burden Is Overwhelming
Author: Oswald Chambers
Site: My Utmost for His Highest
URL: https://utmost.org/updated/what-to-do-when-your-burden-is-overwhelming/
Passage: Psalm 55:22
Points:
- We must distinguish between improper weights like sin and burdens assigned by God.
- Trying to serve God without continual fellowship with Christ causes burnout and defeat.
- Casting a burden onto God means deliberately placing its weight onto His shoulder.
- Handing God our responsibilities replaces overwhelming anxiety with awareness of His presence.
